call_points.text: No numeric FY27 guidance was given; the deck frames strategy only as LEAD&GROW 2030.
FY26 revenue from operations rose 9.3% to ₹3,073 Cr.
FY26 net profit was ₹417 Cr, up 12.3% from ₹371 Cr in FY25.
Business assets turnover improved to 2.83x in FY26 from 2.52x in FY25.
Return on business assets (EBIT excluding investment income) rose to 45.8% in FY26 from 39.5%.
Ceramics & Plastics revenue grew 10.3% in FY26, faster than Abrasives at 6.3%.
Domestic revenue grew at a 12.5% CAGR over FY20-FY26, against 8.5% for exports.
Capex over the last five years totalled about ₹794 Cr, which the deck puts at 6% of revenue.
CSR spend in 2025-26 was ₹9.1 Cr across 26 projects in 19 states, reaching about 19,000 people.
